Key in ~/.config/elevenlabs/.env as ELEVENLABS_API_KEY. - No music. My disk has about 4 GB free. Script: "Most hooks you scroll past are guesses. The ones that work can be measured. Hookline compares each video's views with its creator's usual. This skincare hook did thirty times her usual: 'Stop washing your face twice a day.' It's a line that tells you you're wrong, and it's a shape you can reuse. Ask Claude for the hooks beating their usual in your niche this week. It shows the number on each one, then writes yours. Comment HOOKS and I'll send you the setup."
